verification_note: Only the listed facts were manually read and visually checked against rendered pages of the existing original issuer PDF. The saved issuer disclosure listing contains the exact report URL. This is a scanned filing with no usable statement text layer. PDF page numbers are 1-based and include the disclosure cover; printed statement page is PDF page minus three. The original statements use VND. EPS is a per-share row under VND column headings and is recorded as VND/share. Publication is explicitly stated on the disclosure cover as 19/03/2026; neither the digital-signature time nor statement approval date is treated as publication time. This does not certify any unlisted fact or the entire filing, and does not repair or redate legacy upstream rows.

reconciliation.finding: Total assets equal liabilities plus the original code-400 equity total exactly. Code 400 includes 2,750,000,000 VND of Nguồn kinh phí và quỹ khác; code 410 is 43,745,290,747,539 VND and is not silently substituted for code 400.
Revenue is code-10 net sales/services revenue, not code-01 gross sales/services revenue.
Consolidated net income and net income attributable to parent shareholders are distinct original rows. EPS is per share and is not total parent income.
